description:
Walk every module doc, rustdoc comment, and inline comment in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/`. Identify and reframe assertions that claim OSCAL is "canonical," "the wire format," "the source of truth," or equivalent.

Functional code does not change. Tests do not change. This is purely a documentation framing audit on existing shipped code.

Expected output:
- Inventory of asserted phrases that need softening (list of file:line)
- Applied patch
- Confirmation that `cargo doc --no-deps -p pkix-lint` still builds without warnings

Independent of Phase 1 decisions; can ship in parallel with .8. Coordinate framing with .11 if .6 chooses a rename so the language is internally consistent.
title: Audit pkix-lint/src/oscal/* module docs for 'OSCAL is canonical' assertions
